description: Veriflow Catalog-to-API Automation Mapping Index linking production test catalog IDs to automated API verification checks.

mappings.name: Service health probe verification
mappings.preconditions: Service is running and responds to HTTP requests.

mappings.name: Happy-path API response schema and contract validation
mappings.preconditions: Service returns JSON collection conforming to schema contract.

mappings.name: HTTP 4xx client error presentation and formatting
mappings.preconditions: Endpoint returns structured JSON error when request payload is malformed.

mappings.name: Request timeout and client cancellation handling
mappings.preconditions: Client request aborts cleanly within configured deadline on slow endpoints.

mappings.name: Malformed or non-JSON response defense
mappings.preconditions: Client catches non-JSON payloads defensively without crashing.

mappings.name: HTTP 429 Rate limiting and Retry-After compliance
mappings.preconditions: Rate-limited endpoint emits HTTP 429 with valid Retry-After header.

mappings.name: Third-party integration outage graceful degradation
mappings.preconditions: Downstream dependency outage returns structured degradation payload.

mappings.name: Authentication requirement enforcement on protected endpoints
mappings.preconditions: Protected endpoint returns HTTP 401 when token/cookie is missing.

mappings.name: Role-based access control and privilege denial
mappings.preconditions: Privileged endpoint returns HTTP 403 when non-admin user requests access.

mappings.name: Input validation and constraint enforcement
mappings.preconditions: Endpoint validates fields and returns 400 with details on invalid input.

mappings.name: CRUD data operations and persistence lifecycle
mappings.preconditions: API supports transactional entity lifecycle (create, read, delete, confirm 404).

mappings.name: Server error handling and debug trace suppression
mappings.preconditions: Unhandled 500 errors suppress stack traces, passwords, and file paths.
